causal_contract_rule: among IM contracts active on the event day and not on their last trading day, select highest prior-day open interest; tie-break highest prior-day volume; then nearest expiry

execution_actions.entry: first executable ask at or after frozen trigger: BUY_CLOSE one prior-day historical IM short
execution_actions.exit: first executable bid at or after frozen cash-index exit trigger: SELL_OPEN one IM short to restore hedge

still_required_for_net_replay: effective-dated CFFEX order fee where applicable
cash-index/IM basis at entry and exit
preferred_source: official CFFEX historical Level-1 or Level-2 data, or equivalently authoritative licensed point-in-time feed
warning: CSI1000 3s index observations only narrow cash-index trigger clocks; they are not executable IM quotes and must not be used as futures fills
